it.txt: Era vice-prefeito e assumiu a prefeitura em 01/04/2026, depois que Diego Oliveira renunciou ao cargo para concorrer a deputado estadual na eleição de 2026.
it.txt_en: He was vice mayor and took over as mayor on April 1, 2026, after Mayor Diego Oliveira resigned to run for state deputy in the 2026 election.
